switches.pretravel.measured_on: placeholder: one batch of a common roller-lever micro switch; measure the batch in hand
switches.pretravel.description: travel of the roller from rest to the click

switches.total_travel.measured_on: placeholder: one batch of a common roller-lever micro switch; measure the batch in hand
switches.total_travel.description: travel of the roller from rest to its end

switches.rest_gap_min.measured_on: decided after a roller rubbed a passing ring at 0.8 mm
switches.rest_gap_min.description: least gap between the lever at rest and every surface that passes it

switches.lift_margin.description: cam lift over the pre-travel, and under the total travel

switches.click_before_end_min.description: cam travel between the click and the hard stop

switches.ramp_angle.measured_on: decided: the ramp of the one cam that was printed and worked
switches.ramp_angle.description: ramp angle of a switch cam

switches.pressure_angle_max.description: largest pressure angle between cam and roller

switches.snap_strain_max.description: largest strain of a snap clip while it opens

switches.cradle_fit_per_side.measured_on: one printer: 0.1 to 0.15 per side held a small switch body
switches.cradle_fit_per_side.description: clearance per side between a printed cradle and the switch body

switches.soft_limit_inside_click_min.description: how far the soft limit lies inside the click angle

rules.title: A switch actuator is designed from the measured switch
rules.statement: A switch actuator is designed from the travel measured on the real switch (free, click, end, differential), once per batch: {switches.pretravel} to the click and {switches.total_travel} to the end are placeholders. The vendor model gives the outline only; its measured error is carried as a number.
rules.why: The model showed the roller touching a passing ring: the lever of the vendor model was 1.1 mm too long. The cradles were moved twice.

rules.title: Cam lift, rest gap and the click before the stop
rules.statement: The cam lift lies between the pre-travel and the total travel with a margin of {switches.lift_margin} at every angle the cam covers. At rest the lever keeps at least {switches.rest_gap_min} to every surface that passes it. The end cam clicks at least {switches.click_before_end_min} of cam travel before the hard stop under the worst lever model, and stays pressed through the stop.
rules.why: A roller rubbed a turning ring at 0.8 mm and made noise. A cam tuned to a guessed gap clicked exactly at the stop on the test print.

rules.title: The switch simulation judges this geometry
rules.statement: The lift, the rest gap and the click before the stop of every switch cam are inside their limits in the project's simulation of this geometry.
rules.why: The simulation wrote numbers and its thresholds stood only in its header: nothing judged them.

attest.question: Switch cam: which simulation ran on this geometry, and are lift, rest gap and click inside their limits?
labels: the project simulation ran on this geometry: lift, rest gap and click are inside their limits
no switch cam on this part

rules.note: Deferred: the simulation stays a project script until the gate can run and judge it.

rules.title: A switch cam is one arc with ramps
rules.statement: A switch cam is one continuous arc with ramps of {switches.ramp_angle} and filleted transitions, rising from the bed face: never tabs or steps. The pressure angle stays under {switches.pressure_angle_max}. The cam meets the roller from the pivot side of the lever; for the other direction the switch is turned.
rules.why: The cams of three joints were exported stepped although the proven cam of the first joint was a ramp; the owner flagged them.

rules.title: A switch is held by shape and can be replaced
rules.statement: A small bought sensor sits on the fixed part in a printed cradle (a pad, end walls, pegs) with {switches.cradle_fit_per_side} per side. It is held by shape, by a snap clip sized by strain (a share under {switches.snap_strain_max}), not by friction. Terminals stay open for soldering. The switch can be fitted and replaced on the finished joint. A handed bought part is turned, never mirrored.
rules.why: Switches fell out of press-fit cradles on built joints.

rules.title: One end switch per axis, and it is in the model
rules.statement: One end switch per axis, at its homing end and pressed only there. Homing travel is bounded, so that a dead switch ends in "no trigger" and not in a collision. Switches are wired normally closed. Soft limits follow from the click, release and stop angles with stated margins: at least {switches.soft_limit_inside_click_min} inside the click. The switch, the cam and the sensor of every axis are in the model before it is printed.
rules.why: Placeholder ratios made a built axis run past its switch.

rules.title: A gap from the model is a prediction
rules.statement: A sensor gap predicted from the model is measured on a cheap test print before the final material. The correction goes into the cam radius only. Every gap has a stated tolerance window.
rules.why: A predicted gap was 0.85 mm off on the first print.
